description:
A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness.

DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.
Hotfix for the desktop app.
- Group chats open again in a team imported by 0.2.2 or earlier. Those imports did not copy each group's own conversation, so a click on the group did nothing. At start, the app now copies the missing conversations from the DSH home the team came from; your old DSH home is only read. (#551, #837)
